items.name: The Recursion Meter
items.q: How much of the code that builds AI is now written by AI?
items.build: Count agent-authored pull requests merged into the core AI stacks (PyTorch, Transformers, vLLM, JAX, llama.cpp) each day, as a share of all merged PRs.
items.data: GitHub public API; the agent-PR tracker behind Takeover Watch.
items.measure: A daily share with a 30-day trend line, recomputable from the PR list.

items.name: The Task-Horizon Clock
items.q: How long a job can an AI agent finish on its own?
items.build: Chart the published length of tasks frontier agents complete half the time (METR’s time-horizon measure) and the doubling time it implies.
items.data: METR published results; model release dates.
items.measure: Hours of human work per task, per model, on a log scale.

items.name: Capability Jump Alarm
items.q: When does a new model land far off the trend?
items.build: Fit the trend on public leaderboards and flag any release that beats it by more than two standard deviations.
items.data: LMArena, Epoch AI benchmarks hub, Artificial Analysis.
items.measure: A list of flagged jumps with the size of the gap, each linked to its source.

items.name: The Compute Clock
items.q: How fast is frontier training compute growing?
items.build: A live clock of the largest disclosed training run, with the doubling time from Epoch’s notable-models data.
items.data: Epoch AI notable models dataset (CC BY).
items.measure: FLOP of the largest known run and months per doubling.

items.name: The Lab Silence Index
items.q: Do labs go quiet before a big release?
items.build: Track each lab’s posting cadence (blog, GitHub, X) and mark unusual silences, then check them against what shipped next.
items.data: The newsroom feeds and the Leaders tracker already on SIREN.
items.measure: Days of silence versus each lab’s normal rhythm, scored after the fact.

items.name: Safety Team Exodus Tracker
items.q: Are safety researchers leaving the frontier labs?
items.build: A dated ledger of announced departures from safety and alignment teams, with where people went.
items.data: Public announcements on X, Bluesky and the newsroom.
items.measure: Departures per lab per quarter, every entry sourced.

items.name: System Card Diff
items.q: What new dangers do labs test for with each model?
items.build: Diff each new system card against the last one from the same lab and highlight new dangerous-capability evaluations.
items.measure: New eval categories per release, quoted line by line.

items.name: AGI Timeline Ledger
items.q: How have AI leaders’ stated AGI dates moved?
items.build: Every dated public statement of an AGI or superintelligence year from the people SIREN tracks, plotted over time.
items.data: Leaders tracker, interviews, posts, each linked.
items.measure: Stated year by speaker and date said; shifts shown as arrows.

items.name: Chip Export Watch
items.q: Where are the controls on AI chips tightening?
items.build: Parse Federal Register and Commerce notices for AI-chip export rules and entity-list additions.
items.data: Federal Register API (already a SIREN source).
items.measure: Rules and listings per month, by country named.

items.name: Gigawatt Queue
items.q: How much new power are AI data centres asking the grid for?
items.build: Add up large-load interconnection requests (100 MW and up) by state and grid operator.
items.data: Grid operator queue reports; the SIREN data-centre map.
items.measure: Gigawatts requested per month, per state.

items.name: The Open-Weights Gap
items.q: How many months do open models trail the best closed ones?
items.build: For each capability level, the date a closed model first reached it versus the first open-weights model.
items.measure: The gap in months, over time.

items.name: Daily Turing Test
items.q: Can visitors still tell AI writing from human writing?
items.build: A daily five-question game: pick the human. Results published in aggregate.
items.data: Public-domain human text; outputs from open models.
items.measure: The share of correct guesses each day.

items.name: Government SI Readiness Map
items.q: Which governments have an AI safety body and binding rules?
items.build: A world map of AI safety institutes, AI laws in force and frontier-model reporting rules.
items.measure: A checklist score per country, with every item sourced.

items.name: Alignment-to-Capabilities Ratio
items.q: Is safety research keeping pace with capabilities research?
items.build: Weekly arXiv counts of alignment and interpretability papers against capabilities papers.
items.measure: The ratio each week, with the keyword rules published.

items.name: AI Incident Clock
items.q: How often are new AI incidents being recorded?
items.build: New entries in the public AI incident databases, per week, by harm type.
items.data: AI Incident Database, OECD AI incidents monitor.
items.measure: Incidents per week, each linked to its report.

items.name: Tripwire Registry
items.q: What thresholds have labs promised to stop at?
items.build: Every published frontier safety framework, its capability thresholds, and any public statement that a threshold was reached.
items.data: Lab safety frameworks and system cards.
items.measure: Thresholds per lab and the date each was last tested.

items.name: All the AGI Odds
items.q: What do the forecasting markets say, side by side?
items.build: One chart of AGI-date questions across Metaculus, Polymarket, Kalshi and Manifold, with each question’s own definition.
items.measure: Median dates and prices, each linked to its question.
